description: Source code for component management functions in a network device, including setting parameters, adding/removing instances, and retrieving paths, with extensive licensing and debug macros.

methods.name: component_set_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a specified component via bus context.

methods.name: component_get_path_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the datamodel path of an instance based on a query.

methods.name: component_add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance to a component based on object path and parameters.

methods.name: component_set_str_param
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a component.

methods.name: component_del_instance
methods.description: Deletes an instance identified by object path.

methods.name: component_get_param
methods.description: Fetches a parameter value for a component.

methods.name: component_add_string_to_csv
methods.description: Adds a string to a CSV list parameter of a component.

methods.name: component_remove_string_from_csv
methods.description: Removes a string from a CSV list parameter of a component.

methods.name: component_set_params
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a component.
